group_manifest.proof_strategy: For each witness, derive the common 32-bit alignment equality from requested bounds using quotient/remainder facts and unsigned_last_nbits_eq. Then select the useful generated disjunction/orp branch: the right Coq-disjunct for return_wit_1, the leaked-descriptor branch for return_wit_2, and the descriptor-allocation-failure emp branch for return_wit_3. Instantiate all post existentials from current branch values, unfold CircularAreaAlignedLength plus the relevant descriptor predicate, and cancel unchanged spatial resources.

group_entry.proof_strategy: For each witness, derive the common 32-bit alignment equality from requested bounds using quotient/remainder facts and unsigned_last_nbits_eq. Then select the useful generated disjunction/orp branch: the right Coq-disjunct for return_wit_1, the leaked-descriptor branch for return_wit_2, and the descriptor-allocation-failure emp branch for return_wit_3. Instantiate all post existentials from current branch values, unfold CircularAreaAlignedLength plus the relevant descriptor predicate, and cancel unchanged spatial resources.
group_entry.natural_language_proof_strategy: The C path has already established every semantic fact required by the chosen post branch. The only non-syntactic bridge is that four-byte downward alignment of an unsigned-32 request remains in range, so its generated unsigned_last_nbits wrapper is the mathematical aligned value. Once that equality is exposed, each post predicate unfolds to non-null/zero/reflexive facts present in P, and its heap fragment is exactly the fragment already owned by P.

per_witness_plan.proof_of_CircularAreaInit_return_wit_1: Choose the right Coq-disjunct, prove DescriptorState and AlignedLength as pure assertions, and preserve the same UCharArray.undef_full resource.
per_witness_plan.proof_of_CircularAreaInit_return_wit_2: Choose the leftmost orp branch, instantiate the leaked descriptor with retval and zero/reset values, unfold LeakedDescriptorState, and cancel the eight unchanged field resources.
per_witness_plan.proof_of_CircularAreaInit_return_wit_3: Choose the third orp branch, instantiate the aligned value, establish AlignedLength, and cancel emp.

premise_discharge.alignment_nonnegative: requested>0 and divisor 4>0 imply requested/4>=0, hence aligned_raw>=0
premise_discharge.alignment_upper_bound: requested=4*(requested/4)+(requested mod 4), with remainder in [0,4), implies aligned_raw<=requested<=UINT_MAX
premise_discharge.unsigned_elimination: aligned_raw<=UINT_MAX=2^32-1 supplies the range premise of unsigned_last_nbits_eq
premise_discharge.descriptor_nonnull: the successful/leaked branches carry retval<>0 and the successful buffer branch carries retval_2<>0
premise_discharge.reset_values: callee readidx, writeidx, and b_status equal 0 by explicit PreH hypotheses

group_entry.grouping_reason: One bounded group is appropriate because all 3 witnesses belong to the same function, share the same arithmetic normalization and branch-reconstruction pattern, have no dependency ordering, and 3 is within max_witnesses_per_group=12.
